label: Feelings and Emotions
heading: Egyptian Arabic Feelings and Emotions — 102 Words

examples.arabic: ليلى أكلت الفول والطعمية بتاعتها بحب.
examples.english: Layla ate her foul and ta'ameya with love.
examples.transliteration: Layla akalet el foul we el ta3meya beta3etha be hob.

examples.arabic: مصطفى: يا سلام! أنا بحب الكورة المصرية.
examples.english: Mostafa: Wow! I love Egyptian football.
examples.transliteration: Mostafa: Ya salam! Ana baheb el kora el masreyya.

examples.arabic: انا بحب عيلتي واليوم الدافي ده
examples.english: I love my family and this warm day.
examples.transliteration: ana baheb eilety wel yom eldafy da

examples.arabic: الكل ضحك وبدأ ياكل وكان الجو كله حب وسعادة
examples.english: Everyone laughed and started eating, and the atmosphere was full of love and happiness.
examples.transliteration: El kol dehek we bada yakol we kan el gaw koloh hob we sa'ada

examples.arabic: عندنا فرح سعيد للكل
examples.english: We have a happy wedding for everyone.
examples.transliteration: 'Andena farah sa'eed lel-kol.

examples.arabic: انا سعيد جداً اني هنا في السوق
examples.english: I am very happy that I am here in the market.
examples.transliteration: Ana sa'eed giddan inni hena fil souq.

examples.arabic: بخلص المدرسة وبروح البيت سعيد
examples.english: I finish school and go home happy.
examples.transliteration: Bakhalas el madrasa w baro7 el beit sa3eed.

examples.arabic: أنا وصحابي عايزين نشوف المنتخب في الماتش النهائي.
examples.english: My friends and I want to see the national team in the final match.
examples.transliteration: Ana wa sahabi ayzin neshouf el montakhab fel matsh el neha'i.

examples.arabic: كنا عايزين نشوف التلج لأول مرة في حياتنا عشان مش بنشوفه خالص في القاهرة.
examples.english: We wanted to see the snow for the first time in our lives because we never see it at all in Cairo.
examples.transliteration: Konna ayzin neshouf el talg le awel marra fi hayatna ashan mesh benshoufo khales fi el kahera.

examples.arabic: الرؤساء عايزين سلطة و سيطرة في المنطقة.
examples.english: The presidents want power and control in the region.
examples.transliteration: El-ruasa ayzin sulta wa saytara fi el-mantiqa.
examples.storyTitle: War News on the Day of Eid

examples.arabic: كل واحد في الحتة كان حاسس بفرحة كبيرة عشان الفريق كان بيلعب كويس.
examples.english: Every person in the area was feeling a great joy because the team was playing well.
examples.transliteration: Kol wahed fel hetta kan hases be farha kebira ashan el fariq kan beyelab kways.

examples.arabic: هو كان حاسس بشوية قلق عشان مكنش عنده خبرة.
examples.english: He was feeling a bit of anxiety because he didn't have experience.
examples.transliteration: Huwa kan hassis bi shewayyet alaq ashan ma-kansh ando khibra.

examples.arabic: هو حاسس إنه مبسوط قوي عشان هو بيتعلم كتير.
examples.english: He feels very happy because he is learning a lot.
examples.transliteration: Huwa hases inu mabsut awi ashan huwa biyitalem ketir.

examples.arabic: انا كويس الحمد لله بيتي قريب من هنا تحب تشرب مايه
examples.english: "I'm good, thank God. My house is close by. Would you like to drink some water?"
examples.transliteration: Ana kowayyes el-hamdu lellah. Beyti 'arayyeb men hena. Tehebb teshrob mayya?

examples.arabic: البياع قال له عندي قهوة شاي وعصير تحب ايه
examples.english: The salesman told him, "I have coffee, tea, and juice. What do you like?"
examples.transliteration: El-bayya' al-lo a'andy ahwa shay wa a'seer teheb eh.

examples.arabic: يا احمد تحب تشرب إيه
examples.english: Oh Ahmed what would you like to drink?
examples.transliteration: Ya Ahmed teheb tishrab eh?

examples.arabic: صباح الخير يا استاذة ايمان فيه ايه مالك شكلك مش تمام كدة النهاردة
examples.english: Good morning, Mrs. Iman, what's wrong? You don't look okay today.
examples.transliteration: Sabah el kheir ya ostaza Iman, fee eh malek shaklek mesh tamam kida el naharda?

examples.arabic: صباح الخير يا ام يوسف ايه مالك شايلة هم كده
examples.english: Good morning, Umm Yousef, what's wrong, why do you look so worried?
examples.transliteration: Sabah el-kheir ya Om Yousef, eh malek shayla hamm keda?

examples.arabic: أنا حسيت إن قلبي بيتنطط من السعادة في وسط الجو الجديد ده.
examples.english: I felt that my heart was jumping from happiness in the middle of this new atmosphere.
examples.transliteration: Ana hasset en alby beyetnattat men el saada fi wast el gaw el gedid da.

examples.arabic: بس زمان كان فيه احساس تاني بالحكم وان البلد دي بتاعتنا كلنا مش مجرد احزاب وخلاص
examples.english: But back then there was a different feeling about governance, and that this country was all ours, not just parties and that's it.
examples.transliteration: Bas zamān kān fīh eḥsās tānī bel-ḥokm w en el-balad dī betaʿetna kollena mesh mogarrad aḥzāb w khalas.

examples.arabic: في الشغل بشوف أصحابي وبسمع صوت الضحك وأنا بكون مبسوط
examples.english: At work I see my friends and hear the sound of laughter and I am happy
examples.transliteration: Fi el shoghl bashoof ashabi w basma' sot el dahk w ana bakoon mabsoot

examples.arabic: الضحك والكلام الحلو مال البيت والقلوب كانت فرحانة بلمة العيلة دي
examples.english: Laughter and sweet talk filled the house, and hearts were happy with this family gathering.
examples.transliteration: El-dehk wel-kalam el-helw mal el-beit wel-'oloub kanet farhana belammet el-'eila di

examples.arabic: الكل انفجر من الضحك وواحد فينا قاله وعليكم السلام يا كابتن هو ده الجون الجديد اللي بنلعب عليه ولا إيه
examples.english: Everyone burst into laughter and one of us told him, and upon you be peace, Captain, is this the new goal we are playing for or what?
examples.transliteration: El-kol enfagar men ed-dahk we wahed feena qal-lo wa 'alaykum as-salam ya captain howwa da el-goon el-gedeid elly benil'ab 'aleih walla eih.

examples.arabic: جده قال يا علي انا تعبت من الكلام ده
examples.english: His grandfather said, "Oh Ali, I'm tired of this talk."
examples.transliteration: Geddo 'al ya Ali ana te'ebt men el-kalam dah.
examples.storyTitle: The Little Boy and the Questions

examples.arabic: أحمد كان مبسوط أوي عشان قراره السريع أنقذ شغله النهاردة.
examples.english: Ahmed was very happy because his quick decision saved his work today.
examples.transliteration: Ahmad kan mabsoot awi ashan qararo el-saree ankaz shoghlo el-naharda.

examples.arabic: على مدار الوقت، رسمه اتحسن وبقى مبسوط أوي.
examples.english: Over time, his drawing improved and he became very happy.
examples.transliteration: Ala madar el wa-t, rasmo ethassan we ba-a mabsoot awi.

examples.arabic: دلوقتي هو مبسوط وانا كمان مبسوط
examples.english: Now he is happy and I am also happy
examples.transliteration: delwaaty howa mabsoot wa ana kaman mabsoot

examples.arabic: بس اخويا الصغير زعلان
examples.english: But my young brother is upset.
examples.transliteration: bas akhouya elsoghayer zaalan

examples.arabic: أنا زعلان شوية
examples.english: I am a little upset.
examples.transliteration: Ana za'lan shwaya

examples.arabic: انا سمعت صوت ضحك عالي
examples.english: I heard a loud sound of laughter.
examples.transliteration: ana semaat soot dehk aali

examples.arabic: العيلة كلها اتجمعت على الغدا وفيه ضحك كتير
examples.english: The whole family gathered for lunch and there was a lot of laughter.
examples.transliteration: El eila kolaha etgammet ala el ghada we feh dehk kiteer

examples.arabic: كنت مبسوط اوي بالهدايا والضحك
examples.english: I was very happy with the gifts and laughter.
examples.transliteration: Kont mabsoot awy bel hadaya wel da7k

examples.arabic: انا كنت مبسوط اوي عشان بحبه
examples.english: I was very happy because I love him.
examples.transliteration: ana kont mabsout awy ashan bahebo

examples.arabic: انا بحبه اوي بس محتاج اشرب كوباية شاي عشان اركز معاه
examples.english: I love him very much, but I need to drink a cup of tea to focus with him.
examples.transliteration: Ana bahebbo awi bas mehtag ashrab kobayyet shay 'ashan arakkez ma'aah.

examples.arabic: انا بحس اني مستعجل لكن لازم اكون جاهز
examples.english: I feel rushed but I must be ready.
examples.transliteration: Ana bahess enni mista'gel laken lazim akoun gahez.

examples.arabic: الشعور ده باللمة بيخلينا فرحانين أوي كل مرة.
examples.english: This feeling of gathering makes us very happy every time.
examples.transliteration: El sho'our da bel lamma beykhallina farhanin awi kol marra.

examples.arabic: الاحتفال كان جميل ودي عائلتي اللي بحبها اكتر حاجة في الدنيا
examples.english: The celebration was beautiful, and this is my family whom I love most in the world.
examples.transliteration: El-e7tefal kan gamil we di 3aylti elli bahebba aktar haga fel donya.

examples.arabic: هي كانت بتحب الزيارات بتاعت ولاد الحتة.
examples.english: She used to love the visits of the neighborhood kids.
examples.transliteration: Heya kanet bet7ebb el zeyarat beta3et welad el 7etta.
examples.storyTitle: A Beautiful Day in Our Neighborhood

examples.arabic: قلت له ان الشباب دلوقتي بتحب تلبس الوان كتير في الرياضة
examples.english: I told him that the youth nowadays love to wear many colors in sports.
examples.transliteration: olt loh en el shabab delwaaty betheb telbes alwaan keteer fi el reyada

examples.arabic: هي بتحب السوق التقليدي وانا بحب التسوق الالكتروني او المولات الكبيرة
examples.english: She loves the traditional market, and I love online shopping or big malls.
examples.transliteration: Heyya bethebb es souq el taqleedi wana bahebb el tasawwoq el electrony aw el mollat el kebeera

examples.arabic: خرجت منى من المحل الصغير وهي ماسكة اللمبة الثمينة، وشعور بالفخر والرضا بيغمرها تمامًا.
examples.english: Mona left the small shop, holding the precious lamp, a feeling of pride and satisfaction completely engulfing her.
examples.transliteration: Kharaget Mona men el-maḥall el-soghayyar we heya mas'ka el-lamba el-samina, we sho3oor bel-fakhr wel-reḍa bi-yeghmorha tamaman.
examples.storyTitle: Mona's Journey in Khan el-Khalili: A Morning Full of Greetings

examples.arabic: اتمنى يوم احسن
examples.english: I wish for a better day.
examples.transliteration: Atmanna youm ahsan.

examples.arabic: أحمد الصغير كان بيحب الكورة بتاعتنا جداً.
examples.english: Little Ahmed loved our football very much.
examples.transliteration: Ahmad el soghayar kan by7ebb el kora beta3tna geddan.
examples.storyTitle: Eid Joy and the African Cup in Morocco

examples.arabic: اخويا بيحب الترابيزة الكبيرة
examples.english: My brother loves the big table.
examples.transliteration: Akhouya biheb el tarabeza el kibira

examples.arabic: عمر بيحب البحر وهو فرحان قوي
examples.english: Omar loves the sea and he is very happy.
examples.transliteration: Omar beyheb el baher wa howa farhan awy

examples.arabic: خرجت منى من المحل الصغير وهي ماسكة اللمبة الثمينة، وشعور بالفخر والرضا بيغمرها تمامًا.
examples.english: Mona left the small shop, holding the precious lamp, a feeling of pride and satisfaction completely engulfing her.
examples.transliteration: Kharaget Mona men el-maḥall el-soghayyar we heya mas'ka el-lamba el-samina, we sho3oor bel-fakhr wel-reḍa bi-yeghmorha tamaman.
examples.storyTitle: Mona's Journey in Khan el-Khalili: A Morning Full of Greetings

examples.arabic: الكل ضحك وبدأ ياكل وكان الجو كله حب وسعادة
examples.english: Everyone laughed and started eating, and the atmosphere was full of love and happiness.
examples.transliteration: El kol dehek we bada yakol we kan el gaw koloh hob we sa'ada

examples.arabic: رجعت البيت تعبان بس قلبي كان مليان فرحة.
examples.english: I returned home tired but my heart was full of joy.
examples.transliteration: ragaat el beyt taaban bas alby kan malyan farha.
examples.storyTitle: The Joy of Eid with the Family

examples.arabic: رحت الشغل النهاردة وكنت تعبان اوي
examples.english: I went to work today and I was very tired.
examples.transliteration: roht el shoghl el naharda wa kont taaban awy

examples.arabic: انا برجع البيت تعبان بس مبسوط
examples.english: I go back home tired but happy.
examples.transliteration: ana barga3 el beit ta3ban bas mabsoot

examples.arabic: اخيرا نهى التسوق بتاعه واشترى التي شيرت فقط وهو راضي
examples.english: Finally, he finished his shopping and bought only the t-shirt, feeling satisfied.
examples.transliteration: ʼAkhíran náha t-tasawwoq betáʻu w-eštara t-tī-šērt faqaṭ wa húwwa ráḍi.

examples.arabic: أنا حسيت إن قلبي بيتنطط من السعادة في وسط الجو الجديد ده.
examples.english: I felt that my heart was jumping from happiness in the middle of this new atmosphere.
examples.transliteration: Ana hasset en alby beyetnattat men el saada fi wast el gaw el gedid da.

examples.arabic: انا حسيت بفرحه كبيره اوي
examples.english: I felt very big happiness.
examples.transliteration: Ana hasseyt be farha kebeera awi

examples.arabic: حسيت اني تهت خالص ومبقتش عارف اروح فين
examples.english: I felt completely lost and didn't know where to go.
examples.transliteration: Hassait enny teht khales wamaba'eetsh aref arouh fein.

examples.arabic: قامت بسرعه وهي حاسه بالضيق والتوتر من الوقت الضايع
examples.english: She got up quickly, feeling stressed and anxious about the lost time.
examples.transliteration: Aamet besor'a we heya hassa bel deeq wel tawattor min el wa't el daye'.

examples.arabic: نزلت أجري على السلم وكلي أمل إني أوصل في ميعادي
examples.english: I ran down the stairs, full of hope to arrive on time.
examples.transliteration: Nazalt agri ʿala el-sallem we-kollī amal innī awṣal fī mīʿādī

examples.arabic: كنت قلقانة شوية اني ابوظ الدنيا بس كان عندي امل ان الطبخة تطلع حلوة
examples.english: I was a little worried I'd mess things up but I had hope the dish would turn out good.
examples.transliteration: Kont qal'ana showaya enni abawwaz ed-donya bas kan ʿandi amal enn et-tabkha tetlaʿ helwa.

examples.arabic: هو رجع بيته فرحان في المساء.
examples.english: He returned to his house happy in the evening.
examples.transliteration: Howa rege beto farhan fel masa.

examples.arabic: العيلة هي كل حاجة في حياتي، وأنا فرحان معاهم.
examples.english: Family is everything in my life, and I am happy with them.
examples.transliteration: El eila heya kol haga fee hayaty, we ana farhan maahom.

examples.arabic: هو بيلاقي المفتاح وهو فرحان اوي
examples.english: He finds the key and he is very happy.
examples.transliteration: howa bilaqi el moftah wa howa farhan awi

examples.arabic: هي بتقول يا ريت حد يصلحها دلوقتي
examples.english: She says: "I wish someone would fix it now."
examples.transliteration: Heyya bet'ūl: "Ya rēt ḥadd yiṣlaḥha delwaʾti."

examples.arabic: كان عندنا فرحة كبيرة في بيتنا.
examples.english: We had great joy in our house.
examples.transliteration: Kan 3andena far7a kebira fi betna.
examples.storyTitle: Eid Joy and the African Cup in Morocco

examples.arabic: فجأة، اللاعب المصري جاب جون، وكل الناس صرخوا من الفرحة.
examples.english: Suddenly, the Egyptian player scored a goal, and all the people screamed from joy.
examples.transliteration: Fagaa, el la'eb el masry gab gon, wa kol el nas sarakho mel farha.

examples.arabic: أخويا الكبير أحمد زعق من الفرحة وكلم أمنا فيديو عشان يوريها الجمال ده.
examples.english: My big brother Ahmed shouted with joy and called our mother on video to show her this beauty.
examples.transliteration: Akhoya el kebir Ahmed za'a men el farha we kalem omena video ashan yoriha el gamal da.

examples.arabic: الجو ده بيخليني احس بالدفى وانا قاعده في البيت ومش عايزه اخرج خالص
examples.english: This weather makes me feel warm while I'm at home and don't want to go out at all.
examples.transliteration: el gaw da beykhallini ahess bel dafa wana aada fi el bet w mesh ayza akhrog khales

examples.arabic: الفكرة دي خلتني أحس بأمل كبير.
examples.english: This idea made me feel great hope.
examples.transliteration: El-fekrah di khallitni ahiss be-amal kebir.

examples.arabic: أنا حسيت إن قلبي بيتنطط من السعادة في وسط الجو الجديد ده.
examples.english: I felt that my heart was jumping from happiness in the middle of this new atmosphere.
examples.transliteration: Ana hasset en alby beyetnattat men el saada fi wast el gaw el gedid da.

examples.arabic: رديت عليه وقولتله ازيك يا أحمد واحشني جدا عامل إيه
examples.english: I answered him and said, "How are you, Ahmed? I miss you so much! How are you doing?"
examples.transliteration: Raddayt ʻaleih w olto-llo izzayyak ya Ahmad waheshni giddan ʻamel eih.

examples.arabic: الشعور ده باللمة بيخلينا فرحانين أوي كل مرة.
examples.english: This feeling of gathering makes us very happy every time.
examples.transliteration: El sho'our da bel lamma beykhallina farhanin awi kol marra.

examples.arabic: العيلة كانت مبسوطة تاني بعد كده.
examples.english: The family was happy again after that.
examples.transliteration: El 3eila kanet mabsoota tani ba3d keda.

examples.arabic: طنط خديجة فتحت الباب وهي مبسوطة.
examples.english: Tanta Khadiga opened the door and she was happy.
examples.transliteration: Tanta Khadiga fata7et el bab we hya mabsoota.
examples.storyTitle: A Beautiful Day in Our Neighborhood

examples.arabic: دلوقتي كله تمام وماما مبسوطة
examples.english: Now everything is good and Mom is happy.
examples.transliteration: delwaati kolo tamam we mama mabsouta

examples.arabic: النهاردة، أنا سعيدة أوي.
examples.english: Today, I am very happy.
examples.transliteration: El Naharda, ana sa3ida awi.
examples.storyTitle: An Egyptian Cooking Day in Our Home

examples.arabic: انا قلت له الحمد لله انا كويس وعيلتنا سعيدة جدا
examples.english: I told him Thank God I am good and our family is very happy
examples.transliteration: Ana oltelo elhamdullelah ana kwayes we eiletna saeeda geddan
examples.storyTitle: The Boy and the Many Questions

examples.arabic: كنت سعيدة اوي اني سمعت صوتها الحلو
examples.english: I was very happy that I heard her sweet voice.
examples.transliteration: Kunt sa'eeda awi enni sama't sotaha el helw

examples.arabic: ليلى راحت المحل زعلانة شوية
examples.english: Layla went to the shop a little upset
examples.transliteration: Layla rahet el-mahal za'lana shwaya

examples.arabic: كانت زعلانة قوي ومش عارفة تعمل ايه دلوقتي
examples.english: She was very upset and didn't know what to do now.
examples.transliteration: Kanet za'lana 'awee we mesh 'arfa te'mel eh delwa'ti

examples.arabic: لمبة المطبخ مش شغالة ماما زعلانة جدا
examples.english: The kitchen lightbulb isn't working. Mom is very upset.
examples.transliteration: Lombet el-maṭbakh mesh shaghghāla. Mama zaʿlāna geddan.

examples.arabic: انا اشتريت تفاح صغير واحد بس و روحت بضحك
examples.english: I bought only one small apple and went home laughing.
examples.transliteration: Ana eshtareet toffah soghayyar wahed bas w roht beda7k

examples.arabic: اخيرا وصلت متاخر بس كنت بضحك
examples.english: Finally I arrived late, but I was laughing.
examples.transliteration: Akheeran wasalt muta'akhkhar bas kunt badhak.

examples.arabic: اللحظات دي مهمة جدا وبتخلينا نحس بقيمة العيلة
examples.english: These moments are very important and make us feel the value of family.
examples.transliteration: El laHazaat di muhimma giddan w bitkhalleena naHiss bi qeimet el 3eila.

examples.arabic: سلمت عليه بحرارة وقلتله ازيك يا احمد عامل ايه وحشتني اوي
examples.english: I greeted him warmly and told him "How are you, Ahmed, how are you? I missed you so much."
examples.transliteration: Sallamt 'aleih biharara w-kultelo "Izzayak ya Ahmed, aamel eh? Waheshtani awi!"
